description: Personal migration configuration - curated from actual Mac export on 2026-01-19

Clicking.note: Tap to click - enables single-finger tap as a click

TrackpadThreeFingerDrag.note: Three-finger drag - move windows by dragging with three fingers

TrackpadThreeFingerHorizSwipeGesture.note: Disabled to avoid conflict with three-finger drag

TrackpadThreeFingerTapGesture.note: Disabled to avoid conflict with three-finger drag

TrackpadThreeFingerVertSwipeGesture.note: Disabled to avoid conflict with three-finger drag

TrackpadTwoFingerDoubleTapGesture.note: Smart zoom - double-tap with two fingers to zoom in

TrackpadPinch.note: Pinch to zoom gesture in supported apps

TrackpadRotate.note: Two-finger rotate gesture for image rotation

TrackpadMomentumScroll.note: Inertia scrolling - continues briefly after finger lift

autohide.note: Auto-hide dock for more screen space

magnification.note: Magnify icons on hover for easier targeting

minimize-to-application.note: Minimize windows into their app icon, not separate tiles

mru-spaces.note: Disable auto-rearranging Spaces based on recent use - keeps consistent layout

GloballyEnabled.note: Stage Manager enabled - groups windows by app on side

AppWindowGroupingBehavior.note: Don't group all windows from same app together

HideDesktop.note: Keep desktop visible when using Stage Manager

StandardHideDesktopIcons.note: Show desktop icons in standard (non-Stage Manager) mode

EnableTiledWindowMargins.note: No gaps between tiled windows - maximize screen usage

StageManagerHideWidgets.note: Keep widgets visible when Stage Manager is active

ShowSeconds.note: Display seconds in menu bar clock

ShowDayOfWeek.note: Display day name (Mon, Tue, etc.) in menu bar

com.apple.trackpad.forceClick.note: Enable Force Click - press harder for Quick Look, etc.

AppleEnableMouseSwipeNavigateWithScrolls.note: Disable swipe navigation with mouse scroll wheel

AppleMiniaturizeOnDoubleClick.note: Don't minimize window when double-clicking title bar

com.apple.sound.beep.feedback.note: Play feedback sound when adjusting volume

com.apple.springing.enabled.note: Spring-loading folders - hover to open when dragging

com.apple.springing.delay.note: Spring-loading delay in seconds before folder opens

com.apple.sound.beep.sound.note: System alert sound - Sosumi instead of default Tink

NSStatusItem Visible Battery.note: Hide battery in menu bar (still visible in Control Center)

NSStatusItem Visible Display.note: Hide display brightness in menu bar

Allow Explicit Content.note: Allow explicit content in Siri responses

FXPreferredViewStyle.note: Default to List view (Nlsv=List, icnv=Icon, clmv=Column, Flwv=Gallery)

FXPreferredGroupBy.note: Group by: None - files listed without grouping

ShowStatusBar.note: Show status bar at bottom of Finder windows (item count, disk space)

ShowPathbar.note: Show clickable path bar at bottom of Finder windows

ShowRecentTags.note: Hide recent tags from Finder sidebar

FXDefaultSearchScope.note: Search current folder by default (SCcf=Current Folder, SCsp=Previous Scope, SCev=This Mac)

NewWindowTarget.note: New Finder windows open to Home folder (PfHm=Home, PfDe=Desktop, PfDo=Documents, PfCm=Computer)

FXICloudDriveDesktop.note: Sync Desktop folder to iCloud Drive

FXICloudDriveDocuments.note: Sync Documents folder to iCloud Drive

ShowExternalHardDrivesOnDesktop.note: Show external hard drives on Desktop

ShowRemovableMediaOnDesktop.note: Show CDs, DVDs, and iPods on Desktop

ShowHardDrivesOnDesktop.note: Hide internal hard drives from Desktop

WarnOnEmptyTrash.note: Show warning dialog before emptying Trash

FXEnableExtensionChangeWarning.note: Show warning when changing file extensions
